scope: Theorem 3.1 of the manuscript “Strongly rational unitary vertex operator algebras and conformal nets” (preprints/Strongly-rational-unitary-vertex-operator-algebras-and-conformal-nets-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 280 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5f09142bda3ec3d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V be a simple unitary strongly rational vertex operator algebra, and let W be a grading-restricted unitary V -module. Every vertex operator on W satisfies polynomial energy bounds. More precisely, if a ∈ Vd is quasi-primary, d ≥ 2, and (−1)dΘa = a, then there are constants Ca > 0 and pa ∈ Z≥0 such that ∥a[m]ξ∥ ≤ Ca(1 + |m|)pa ∥(1 + L0)d−1 ξ∥, m ∈ Z, ξ ∈ W. (3.1) Weight-one fields and the Virasoro field satisfy energy bounds of at most linear order. The constants may depend on V , W, and a.
